extensionDescription.message: Keep websites beside your work. Save favorites, reopen recent pages, and bind a sidebar page to a tab when needed.

openCurrentCommand.message: Open the current page in SideBrowser

recentEmpty.message: No recent pages. Your last 10 explicitly opened addresses appear here.

openCurrent.description: Compact toolbar button: copy the active browser tab URL into the sidebar.

openCurrentTitle.message: Open the current browser tab in the sidebar

openExternal.description: More menu: open the sidebar URL in a normal browser tab.

openExternalTitle.message: Open the sidebar page in a new browser tab

mobileModeTitle.message: Mobile mode is on. Switch to desktop mode

desktopModeTitle.message: Desktop mode is on. Switch to mobile mode

loadingSlow.message: This page is taking a while to load. Reload it, or use “⋯” to open it in a new tab.

errorUnsupportedScheme.message: Enter an HTTP or HTTPS address, or a search term.

errorInvalidUrl.message: This address is not valid. Check it and try again.

errorHttpOnly.message: Only HTTP and HTTPS websites are supported.

errorEmptyInput.message: Enter an address or search term, or choose “Open current page”.

errorChromeVersion.message: Could not read the browser version. Mobile mode has not been enabled.

errorExtensionUnavailable.message: The extension did not respond. Try again.

errorPanelOnly.message: This action is only available in the SideBrowser sidebar.

errorWindowClosed.message: The sidebar window has been closed.

errorCurrentPage.message: The current page does not have an HTTP or HTTPS address to open.

helpLanguage.message: The interface language follows your browser automatically.

helpStartNavigation.message: Click the SideBrowser extension icon to open the sidebar. Enter an address or search term and press Enter. Use “Open current page” to open the active tab’s address in the sidebar.

helpStartShortcut.message: Right-click a webpage, link, or the extension toolbar icon to open it in SideBrowser. The default open-current-page shortcut is Alt + Shift + P (Mac: ⌥ + ⇧ + P); view or change it in Settings. Drag the sidebar edge to resize it.

helpStatePersistence.message: All unbound tabs in a window share one side page. Choose “⋯” → “Bind to current tab” to keep the displayed side page with that tab. Bound pages retain their state when switching tabs; other tabs continue sharing. Unbinding returns to the shared page, and closing a bound tab releases its page.

helpStateRestore.message: Binding transfers the current live page to that tab and clears the shared page and its history. Unbound tabs show the welcome screen until you open another shared page. Reopening the sidebar restores saved addresses for this browser session, but unsaved input may be lost. Restarting the browser clears bindings and restores the shared address.

helpMobileViewport.message: Mobile/desktop mode is shared across windows. Switching mode reloads every running side page. Mobile mode adapts the viewport and browser identity while keeping mouse, hover, and scroll-wheel support; it is not full device emulation.

helpEmbeddingLimits.message: If a page loads slowly, try reloading it. Some websites, sign-in flows, or videos may not work in the sidebar. Use “⋯” to open the current page in a new tab.

helpPrivacy.message: Favorites, recents, preferences, and restoration URLs/history stay on your device and are not uploaded to the developer. Deleting favorites or clearing recents affects only that list, not the other list, running pages, navigation history, or website cookies. Websites and search providers handle their own requests and input under their privacy policies.

settingsIntro.message: Manage your browsing preferences. Changes are saved automatically.

settingsModeDescription.message: Shared across all windows. Switching modes reloads the page in every open sidebar.

settingsShortcutDescription.message: Open the active tab in the sidebar. You can change this shortcut in your browser.

settingsRecentDescription.message: Keep your last 10 explicitly opened addresses for easy access. Clearing the list does not close your page or sign you out of websites.

settingsClearConfirmation.message: Clear all recently opened entries? This cannot be undone.

errorSettingsOnly.message: Open SideBrowser settings to perform this action.

helpRecent.message: Click the address-bar clock to see your last 10 explicitly opened addresses. Reopening moves an entry to the top. Internal page navigation, reloads, and back/forward do not add entries. Remove individual entries or clear the list. Recents are shared across windows and survive restarts; clearing them leaves favorites intact.

helpFeedbackDescription.message: Found a problem or have an idea? Let us know on GitHub.

settingsThemeDescription.message: Applies to the sidebar and webpages that follow the system theme. Some sites use their own theme setting. Switching appearance keeps the current page open.

emptyKeepHint.message: Your page stays here when you switch tabs.

emptyModeHint.message: Use “⋯” at the top right to switch between mobile and desktop views.

closePageTitle.message: Close the webpage and keep the sidebar open

helpClosePage.message: Choose “⋯” → “Close current page” to return to welcome while keeping the sidebar open. Only the displayed page and its back/forward history are cleared. Favorites, recents, tab bindings, preferences, and other side pages remain. The closed page will not automatically return when you reopen the sidebar or restart your browser.

bindTabDescription.message: Keep this side page with the current tab. Other unbound tabs keep sharing a page.

unbindTabDescription.message: Release this binding and return to the shared page.

helpFavorites.message: Choose “⋯” → “Add current page to favorites” to save the sidebar page. You can also right-click a webpage or the SideBrowser toolbar icon and choose “Add to SideBrowser favorites”; this saves the page without opening it.

helpFavoriteShortcuts.message: Favorites appear below the empty welcome screen as website icons. They wrap into new rows when needed. Hover or focus an icon to see its title and full URL; click to open it in the current sidebar. Remove a favorite with its delete button or “⋯” → “Remove from favorites”. Favorites are shared across windows, survive restarts, and are separate from browser bookmarks.

helpAppearance.message: Choose light, dark, or system appearance in Settings or “⋯”. Appearance is shared across windows and changes without reloading pages. Websites may use their own theme settings. The interface follows your browser’s language; English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, German, French, and Spanish are supported.

settingsSearchEngineDescription.message: Used for keyword searches in every sidebar. Results open in the sidebar.
